Q136202496.label: 2025 Russian drone incursion into Poland
Q136202496.desc: military incident between Russia and Poland amidst the Russian invasion of Ukraine
Q136202496.img: 9-10 September 2025 Russian drone incursion into Poland.jpg
Q136202496.summary: On 9 September 2025, at about 11:30 p.m. CEST, over 30 unarmed military drones entered Poland's airspace after allegedly being launched from Russia. The incursion triggered a Quick Reaction Alert; the Polish Air Force and other NATO militaries scrambled aircraft. Up to four drones were confirmed to have been shot down, most by the Dutch Air Force.

Q12544.label: Byzantine Empire
Q12544.desc: Roman Empire during Late Antiquity and the Middle Ages
Q12544.summary: The Byzantine Empire, also known as the Eastern Roman Empire, was the continuation of the Eastern part of the Roman Empire centred on Constantinople during late antiquity and the Middle Ages. Having survived the fall of the Western Roman Empire in the 5th century AD, it endured until the fall of Constantinople to the Ottoman Empire in 1453. The term 'Byzantine Empire' was coined only after its demise; its citizens used the term 'Roman Empire' and called themselves 'Romans'.

Q1166592.label: Darrell Issa
Q1166592.summary: Darrell Edward Issa is an American businessman and politician serving as the U.S. representative for California's 48th congressional district. He represented the 50th congressional district from 2021 to 2023. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served in the United States House of Representatives from 2001 to 2019, representing two districts primarily covering North County in the San Diego area: first the 48th district for one term and then the 49th district for eight terms. From January 2011 to January 2015, he chaired the House Oversight and Government Reform Committee.

Q107264.label: Robert Lucas
Q107264.img: La Revolución Industrial Pasado y Futuro, Robert E. Lucas Jr. screenshot (cropped).jpg
Q107264.summary: Robert Emerson Lucas Jr. was an American economist at the University of Chicago. Widely regarded as the central figure in the development of the new classical approach to macroeconomics, he received the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences in 1995 "for having developed and applied the hypothesis of rational expectations, and thereby having transformed macroeconomic analysis and deepened our understanding of economic policy". N. Gregory Mankiw characterized him as "the most influential macroeconomist of the last quarter of the 20th century".

Member of: American Academy of Arts and Sciences

Q16836864.label: Finnish nationalism
Q16836864.desc: nationalistic ideology about the culture and ethnicity of Finnish people
Q16836864.summary: Finnish nationalism was a central force in the history of Finland starting in the 19th century. The Finnish national awakening in the mid-19th century was the result of members of the Swedish-speaking upper classes deliberately choosing to promote Finnish culture and language as a means of nation building - i.e. to establish a feeling of unity between all people in Finland including between the ruling elite and the ruled peasantry.
